purpose: 100-epoch MSB mantissa training from fresh initialization with original dynamic x64 scales
weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
activation_policy: original A32/ReLU in ALL THREE modes
mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
mx_scale_policy: encode current E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; both lower scale codes equal source code+6; integer promoted before addition; overflow above254 rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks; source scales can change after optimizer steps
mx_rounding: unchanged E4M3 nearest ties-to-even encoder; E4-to-E2M3 exact exponent mapping; E2M3-to-E2M1 constrained minimum absolute-error exponent with retained m0
ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) for E4M3 and complete scale64 E4-to-E2 code path; no extra factor64 in backward; retain original G(W) derivatives; no gradient through codes or scales
numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
mantissa_mapping: retain E2M3 m0; Eprime=min(3,E+int(m==6)); preserve sign and E2 scale
source_cache_policy: detached integer source and derived codes; one triplet per minibatch; cleared before Adam
loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
batchnorm_policy: normal training updates of three mode banks E4M3=8,E2M3=32,E2M1=4; parameters and running stats learn per mode; eval frozen; keys are storage IDs, all A32; banks1/2 unused
initialization_policy: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
evaluation_policy: all three modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for each
selection_policy: fixed epoch100 endpoint; no best-test checkpoint selection
reporting_policy: new MSB epochs1-100 versus recorded historical LSB x64 epochs1-100; endpoint100 for both; previous pilot observations are not part of this run
rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
checkpoint_policy: immutable complete FP32 model/Adam/scheduler/RNG checkpoint at each completed epoch
export_policy: full resume checkpoints with explicit MSB method contract; no legacy LSB compact exports
limitations: one new MSB run and one historical LSB run; no repeated seeds
fixed 100-epoch budget does not prove convergence or globally optimal hyperparameters
historical model initialization hash is available; historical initial RNG and sample-order files are not
same seed and source policy do not prove identical historical sample order or bit-exact CUDA execution
shared masters and three trainable BN banks can change W4, W6 and W8 results
official test reused for reporting; fixed epoch100 endpoint, no best-test selection
previous independent-scale posthoc scores are not a matched baseline for this training
new epoch timings include additional mapping/decode/gradient audits and are not a controlled speed comparison with historical LSB
FP32 emulation and diagnostic timing do not measure native low-bit hardware cost
